name: io.github.verilineapi/veriline-mcp
title: Veriline API
description: MCP tools for Veriline email, VAT/LEI/IBAN, and US NPI APIs via API.market.

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API.market subscriber key. Get one by subscribing to a Veriline API at https://api.market

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional org/base URL. Defaults to https://prod.api.market/api/v1/veriline (documented pattern; confirm after listing approval).

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_AUTH_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Optional buyer auth header name. Defaults to x-api-market-key (confirmed in official API.market docs).

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_EMAIL_AUDITOR_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional full base URL for the Email Deliverability Auditor product.

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_BUSINESS_ID_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional full base URL for the Business & Tax-ID Verification product.

environmentVariables.name: VERILINE_NPI_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional full base URL for the US NPI Lookup product.
